run_evaluate_hexagon_packing: run the evaluator on a hexagon packing program and return the combined score and eval time
run_verify_construction: verify a hexagon packing construction by checking disjointness and containment of inner hexagons
create_hexagon_vertices: create the six vertices of a regular hexagon given its center, side length, and rotation angle
test_polygons_intersect: test whether two polygons intersect using the separating axis theorem with configurable tolerance
test_hexagons_are_disjoint: test whether two hexagons are disjoint given their center, side length, and rotation parameters
